description: Header file defining the Tokenizer class for tokenizing input files in GN build system, including enums, class declarations, and method signatures.

classes.name: Tokenizer
classes.description: Class responsible for tokenizing input files, providing static methods for tokenization and internal methods for parsing.

methods.name: Tokenize
methods.description: Static method to tokenize an input file into a vector of tokens.

methods.name: ByteOffsetOfNthLine
methods.description: Counts lines in a buffer and returns the byte offset of the nth line.

methods.name: IsNewline
methods.description: Checks if a specific offset in the buffer is a newline.

methods.name: IsIdentifierFirstChar
methods.description: Checks if a character can start an identifier.

methods.name: IsIdentifierContinuingChar
methods.description: Checks if a character can continue an identifier.

methods.name: ClassifyToken
methods.description: Classifies a token based on current and following characters.

methods.name: GetCurrentLocation
methods.description: Returns the current location in the input file.

methods.name: GetErrorForInvalidToken
methods.description: Generates an error for an invalid token at a given location.
